name: macroverdeling
description: Trainingsgerichte macro- en voedingsschemaplanner (Nederlands), als installeerbare PWA.

scripts.test: for f in tests/*.mjs; do node "$f" > /tmp/nexa-test.log 2>&1 && ! grep -q "^FOUT" /tmp/nexa-test.log || { cat /tmp/nexa-test.log; echo "FOUT in $f"; exit 1; }; echo "ok  $f"; done
